scope: Measured from the current development workspace. Mainland China carrier connectivity has not been directly tested.
notes: Every installed model file must still match the pinned complete SHA-256 and byte size. Range probes are availability evidence, not complete-file integrity verification.
ModelScope independent copies were checked against fixed revisions and matching API-reported SHA-256 values.
HF Mirror large weight responses currently redirect to us.aws.cdn.hf.co; keep ModelScope as an independent route.
GitHub proxies were tested with an existing 650 MB release asset and the 54 MB vocoder. Newly published runtime archives require separate verification.
gh-proxy.com may return HTTP 200 for a Range request; restart from byte zero when a server ignores Range.
No expiring signed redirect URLs are retained.
